platform_info.name: WhatsApp Group Chat
platform_info.description: Handles WhatsApp group chat exports in plain-text format. Multiple date/time formats and locales are supported. These data donation flows have not been tested yet, if you find anything wrong with them report to datadonation@uu.nl and they will be fixed!

description.en: The messages in your group chat, sorted by time. Try searching to filter the messages and see what your group was talking about at different moments.
description.nl: De berichten in uw groepschat, gesorteerd op tijd. Probeer te zoeken om de berichten te filteren en te zien waar uw groep op verschillende momenten over sprak.
